quotes.confounding: None of the absolute standardized mean differences in the variables included in the propensity score estimation exceeded 0.1; hence, the propensity score matching achieved an acceptable match balance. ... Although instrumental variable analysis allowed for adjustment of unmeasured confounders and demonstrated consistent benefit of tranexamic acid administration for 28-day all-cause mortality, this method was not versatile in that it showed uncertainty with a much broader c.i.
quotes.selection: This multicentre observational study used retrospectively collected data from consecutive injured patients (Injury Severity Score at least 16) treated in 15 Japanese academic institutions in 2012.
quotes.classification: The intervention involved intravenous administration of tranexamic acid within 3 h after injury, which was identical to a secondary analysis of the CRASH-2 trial.
quotes.deviations: The design of the CRASH-2 trial allowed exclusion of a subject when the physician found an indication or contraindication to tranexamic acid administration in an individual injured patient.
quotes.missingData: a multiple imputation by chained equations complemented all of the missing values in the study variables
quotes.measurement: The primary study outcome was 28-day mortality from any cause.
quotes.reporting: All statistical analyses were performed... In all statistical analyses, statistical significance in the two-sided test was accepted at P <0.050.
